name: cloudflare_create_dns_record
description: Create a new DNS record in a zone. Requires `zone_id`, `type` (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, NS, SRV, CAA, ...), `name` (full record name, e.g. 'www.example.com'), and `content` (the value: an IPv4 for A, IPv6 for AAAA, a hostname for CNAME/MX, the string for TXT). Optional `ttl` (seconds; 1 = automatic), `proxied` (true to route through Cloudflare's proxy — only for A/AAAA/CNAME), `priority` (required for MX/SRV), and `comment`. This changes live DNS — confirm the zone and values first.

zone_id.description: The zone id to create the record in.

name.description: Full record name, e.g. 'www.example.com' (use the zone apex name for the root).

content.description: Record value: IPv4 for A, IPv6 for AAAA, hostname for CNAME/MX, string for TXT.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds. 1 means 'automatic'. Forced to auto when proxied.

proxied.description: Route through Cloudflare's proxy (orange cloud). Only valid for A, AAAA, CNAME. Default false.

priority.description: Priority — required for MX and SRV records (lower = higher priority).

comment.description: Optional note stored on the record.
